en: The Duchy of Athens as one of the Crusader states established in Greece after the Fourth Crusade
Its rule by Burgundian, Catalan and later Florentine and Venetian families until the Ottoman conquest
zh: 雅典公国是第四次十字军后在希腊建立的十字军国家之一
先后由勃艮第、加泰罗尼亚、佛罗伦萨与威尼斯家族统治，后被奥斯曼征服

politics.zh: 雅典公国是第四次十字军后在希腊建立的十字军国家之一，1205年由勃艮第骑士建立，以雅典与底比斯为中心。它先后由拉罗什家族、加泰罗尼亚雇佣军团、佛罗伦萨的阿奇亚约利家族与威尼斯人统治，实行西欧封建制度并保留拜占庭地方行政，1458年被奥斯曼帝国征服。
politics.en: The Duchy of Athens was one of the Crusader states established in Greece after the Fourth Crusade, founded by Burgundian knights in 1205 with Athens and Thebes as its centres. It was ruled in turn by the de la Roche family, the Catalan Company, the Florentine Acciaioli and the Venetians, combining western European feudal institutions with surviving Byzantine local administration, and was conquered by the Ottomans in 1458.

economy.zh: 经济以阿提卡与维奥蒂亚的农业、橄榄油生产以及雅典港的贸易为基础，比雷埃夫斯与底比斯的市场连接爱琴海商路，丝绸与橄榄油是重要出口品。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming in Attica and Boeotia, olive oil production and trade through the port of Athens, with the markets of Piraeus and Thebes linked to Aegean routes and silk and olive oil among the leading exports.

culture.zh: 雅典公国留下雅典卫城的拉丁改造与哥特式建筑痕迹，加泰罗尼亚与意大利统治带来不同的文化影响，希腊东正教与拉丁教会并存，雅典作为古典学术象征的地位被重新发现。
culture.en: The duchy left traces of Latin adaptation and Gothic building on the Acropolis, Catalan and Italian rule bringing different cultural influences, the Greek Orthodox and Latin churches coexisting, and Athens being rediscovered as a symbol of classical learning.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1205年公国建立、1311年加泰罗尼亚人夺取政权、14世纪后期阿奇亚约利家族的统治，以及1458年被奥斯曼帝国征服。
events.en: Key moments are the establishment of the duchy in 1205, the Catalan seizure of power in 1311, the rule of the Acciaioli in the later fourteenth century and the Ottoman conquest of 1458. Its monuments were later studied by travellers from western Europe.

value.en: It was founded by Burgundian knights in 1205.
It was conquered by the Ottomans in 1458.

en: The Duchy of Brunswick as a historical German state that ceased to exist in 1918
Its rule by the House of Welf and its reorganisation in the nineteenth century
zh: 不伦瑞克公国是1918年终结的德意志历史邦国
由韦尔夫家族统治，19世纪多次重组

politics.zh: 不伦瑞克公国是1918年终结的德意志历史邦国，位于德国西北部，1814年由不伦瑞克-沃尔芬比特尔公国改组而成，由韦尔夫家族统治，以不伦瑞克为首府。它在19世纪经历摄政与继承争议，1866年后与普鲁士关系密切，1871年加入德意志帝国；1918年革命后君主制被废，其地成为不伦瑞克自由邦。
politics.en: The Duchy of Brunswick was a historical German state that ceased to exist in 1918, lying in north-western Germany and formed in 1814 out of the Duchy of Brunswick-Wolfenbuttel, ruled by the House of Welf with Brunswick as its capital. It went through regency and succession disputes in the nineteenth century, was closely tied to Prussia after 1866 and joined the German Empire in 1871; the revolution of 1918 abolished its monarchy and its territory became the Free State of Brunswick.

economy.zh: 经济以农业、矿业、制糖与机械制造为基础，不伦瑞克是行政与商业中心，19世纪铁路与工业发展推动经济转型，钾盐与褐煤开采具有重要地位。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming, mining, sugar refining and machinery manufacturing, with Brunswick as the administrative and commercial centre, railways and industry driving change in the nineteenth century, and potash and lignite mining holding an important place.

culture.zh: 不伦瑞克公国留下宫殿、园林与剧院遗产，宫廷赞助音乐与科学，不伦瑞克工业大学与博物馆体系建立，韦尔夫家族的收藏成为地方文化的重要部分。
culture.en: The duchy left palaces, gardens and a theatre as heritage, its court patronising music and science, the technical university and museums of Brunswick being founded, and the collections of the House of Welf forming an important part of local culture.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1814年公国建立、1830年与1884年的继承与摄政争议、1871年加入德意志帝国，以及1918年革命后成为不伦瑞克自由邦。
events.en: Key moments are the creation of the duchy in 1814, the succession and regency disputes of 1830 and 1884, its accession to the German Empire in 1871 and its transformation into the Free State of Brunswick after the revolution of 1918.

value.zh: 1814年由不伦瑞克-沃尔芬比特尔公国改组而成。
value.en: It was formed in 1814 out of the Duchy of Brunswick-Wolfenbuttel.

value.zh: 1918年革命后成为不伦瑞克自由邦。
value.en: After the revolution of 1918 it became the Free State of Brunswick.

en: The Taifa of Silves as an Arab taifa kingdom in what is now southern Portugal
Its control of the Algarve coast and its absorption by Seville and later the Almoravids
zh: 锡尔维什泰法是今葡萄牙南部的阿拉伯泰法王国
控制阿尔加维海岸，后被塞维利亚与阿尔摩拉维德吞并

politics.zh: 锡尔维什泰法是今葡萄牙南部的阿拉伯泰法王国，11世纪初在科尔多瓦哈里发国解体后建立，控制阿尔加维海岸与锡尔维什、法鲁一带的港口。它凭借大西洋与地中海之间的航路发展贸易，与塞维利亚、巴达霍斯等泰法互动；11世纪中叶被塞维利亚吞并，此后先后由阿尔摩拉维德与阿尔摩哈德统治，1249年被葡萄牙国王阿方索三世征服。
politics.en: The Taifa of Silves was an Arab taifa kingdom in what is now southern Portugal, established in the early eleventh century as the Caliphate of Cordoba broke up and controlling the Algarve coast with the ports of Silves and Faro. It developed trade along the routes between the Atlantic and the Mediterranean and interacted with the taifas of Seville and Badajoz; in the mid-eleventh century it was absorbed by Seville and afterwards held by the Almoravids and Almohads, until Alfonso III of Portugal conquered it in 1249.

economy.zh: 经济以阿尔加维海岸的港口贸易、渔业、农业与手工业为基础，锡尔维什是区域市场与造船地，柑橘、干果、皮革与海产是重要交换物，港口连接北非与北欧航路。
economy.en: The economy rested on port trade along the Algarve coast, fishing, farming and crafts, with Silves a regional market and shipbuilding centre, citrus, dried fruit, hides and marine produce among the goods exchanged, and its harbours linking North African and northern European routes.

culture.zh: 锡尔维什泰法属安达卢斯文化圈，阿拉伯语诗歌与学术在此流传，城堡、城墙与水利设施留下遗存，港口城市融合阿拉伯、北非与本地传统，为后来的葡萄牙南部留下物质遗产。
culture.en: The taifa belonged to the cultural world of Al-Andalus, Arabic poetry and scholarship circulating there, its castle, walls and water works surviving as remains, its port city combining Arab, North African and local traditions, and it left a material legacy in what became southern Portugal.

events.zh: 关键节点包括11世纪初泰法建立、11世纪中叶被塞维利亚吞并、12世纪由阿尔摩拉维德与阿尔摩哈德统治，以及1249年被葡萄牙征服。
events.en: Key moments are the establishment of the taifa in the early eleventh century, its absorption by Seville in the mid-eleventh, Almoravid and Almohad rule in the twelfth and its conquest by Portugal in 1249. Its harbour works are still visible along the Algarve coast.

value.zh: 位于今葡萄牙南部阿尔加维海岸。
value.en: It lay on the Algarve coast of what is now southern Portugal.

value.zh: 1249年被葡萄牙国王阿方索三世征服。
value.en: Alfonso III of Portugal conquered it in 1249.

en: Lithuania, officially the Republic of Lithuania, as a country in the Baltic region of Europe
Its position as one of the three Baltic states, with the Baltic Sea to the west and borders with Latvia, Belarus, Poland and the Kaliningrad region
zh: 立陶宛正式称立陶宛共和国，是欧洲波罗的海地区国家
为波罗的海三国之一，西临波罗的海，邻拉脱维亚、白俄罗斯、波兰与加里宁格勒

politics.zh: 立陶宛共和国是欧洲波罗的海地区国家，为波罗的海三国之一，西临波罗的海，邻拉脱维亚、白俄罗斯、波兰与加里宁格勒，首都为维尔纽斯。它在中世纪建立大公国，1569年与波兰组成联邦，18世纪被瓜分，1918年独立，1940年被苏联吞并，1990年率先宣布恢复独立，2004年加入欧盟与北约。
politics.en: Lithuania, officially the Republic of Lithuania, is a country in the Baltic region of Europe and one of the three Baltic states, with the Baltic Sea to the west and borders with Latvia, Belarus, Poland and the Kaliningrad region, and Vilnius as its capital. It formed a grand duchy in the Middle Ages, entered a union with Poland in 1569, was partitioned in the eighteenth century, became independent in 1918, was annexed by the Soviet Union in 1940, declared the restoration of its independence in 1990 as the first of the Soviet republics to do so, and joined the European Union and NATO in 2004.

economy.zh: 经济以制造业、信息技术、激光与生物技术、农业与服务业为基础，维尔纽斯与考纳斯是工业与商业中心，木材、机械与电子产品是重要出口品，与欧盟市场联系紧密。
economy.en: The economy rests on manufacturing, information technology, laser and biotechnology, farming and services, with Vilnius and Kaunas as centres of industry and commerce, timber, machinery and electronic products among the leading exports, and close links with the EU market.

culture.zh: 立陶宛文化以立陶宛语与波罗的海传统为基础，天主教传统深厚，民歌与十字架山等遗产著名，维尔纽斯老城被列为世界遗产，文学与音乐在近代民族运动中作用重要。
culture.en: Lithuanian culture rests on the Lithuanian language and Baltic tradition, with a deep Catholic heritage, folk song and sites such as the Hill of Crosses well known, the old town of Vilnius listed as World Heritage, and literature and music playing an important part in the modern national movement.

events.zh: 关键节点包括中世纪大公国的建立、1569年与波兰联合、18世纪被瓜分、1918年独立、1940年被苏联吞并，以及1990年恢复独立与2004年加入欧盟。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the grand duchy in the Middle Ages, the union with Poland in 1569, the partitions of the eighteenth century, independence in 1918, annexation by the Soviet Union in 1940 and the restoration of independence in 1990 with accession to the European Union in 2004.

value.en: In 1569 it entered a union with Poland.
In 1990 it was the first Soviet republic to declare the restoration of independence.

en: The Kingdom of Hanover as a German state established by the Congress of Vienna in 1814
Its union with the British crown until 1837 and its annexation by Prussia in 1866
zh: 汉诺威王国是1814年维也纳会议建立的德意志邦国
1837年前与英国王位联合，1866年被普鲁士兼并

politics.zh: 汉诺威王国是1814年维也纳会议建立的德意志邦国，由汉诺威选侯国升格而来，1814至1837年与英国王位共主，此后由韦尔夫家族单独统治，以汉诺威为首府。它在1837年因继承法差异与英国分离，1866年在普奥战争中支持奥地利，战败后被普鲁士兼并，其地成为普鲁士汉诺威省。
politics.en: The Kingdom of Hanover was a German state established by the Congress of Vienna in 1814, raised from the electorate of Hanover and in personal union with the British crown from 1814 to 1837, after which it was ruled separately by the House of Welf with Hanover as its capital. In 1837 differences in succession law separated it from Britain, and in 1866 it sided with Austria in the war and was annexed by Prussia after defeat, becoming the Prussian province of Hanover.

economy.zh: 经济以北德平原的农业、畜牧业、纺织业与港口贸易为基础，汉诺威与埃姆登是商业与航运中心，19世纪铁路建设与工业发展推动经济转型。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming and herding on the north German plain, textiles and port trade, with Hanover and Emden as centres of commerce and shipping, and railway building and industrial growth driving change in the nineteenth century.

culture.zh: 汉诺威王国留下宫殿、园林与大学遗产，哥廷根大学是重要学术中心，宫廷赞助音乐与建筑，低地德语与地方民俗传统延续，1851年建成的汉诺威动物园闻名欧洲。
culture.en: The kingdom left palaces, gardens and a university as heritage, the University of Gottingen being an important scholarly centre, its court patronising music and architecture, Low German speech and local folklore continuing, and the zoological garden opened in Hanover in 1851 becoming famous in Europe.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1814年王国建立、1837年与英国分离、1866年普奥战争中被普鲁士兼并，以及此后成为普鲁士汉诺威省。
events.en: Key moments are the establishment of the kingdom in 1814, the separation from Britain in 1837, its annexation by Prussia in the war of 1866 and its later existence as the Prussian province of Hanover.

value.en: It was established by the Congress of Vienna in 1814.

en: The Czech Republic, also known as Czechia and historically known as Bohemia, as a landlocked country in Central Europe
Its borders with Germany, Austria, Slovakia and Poland
zh: 捷克又称捷克亚，历史上称波希米亚，是中欧内陆国家
邻德国、奥地利、斯洛伐克与波兰

politics.zh: 捷克共和国又称捷克亚，历史上称波希米亚，是中欧内陆国家，邻德国、奥地利、斯洛伐克与波兰，首都为布拉格。它在9世纪形成波希米亚国家，曾为神圣罗马帝国与奥匈帝国的一部分，1918年与斯洛伐克组成捷克斯洛伐克，1993年和平分立；此后实行议会制共和政体，1999年加入北约，2004年加入欧盟。
politics.en: The Czech Republic, also known as Czechia and historically known as Bohemia, is a landlocked country in Central Europe, bordered by Germany, Austria, Slovakia and Poland, with Prague as its capital. A Bohemian state took shape there in the ninth century, and it later formed part of the Holy Roman Empire and Austria-Hungary; in 1918 it joined Slovakia in Czechoslovakia and in 1993 the two separated peacefully, since when it has been a parliamentary republic, joining NATO in 1999 and the European Union in 2004.

economy.zh: 经济以汽车制造、机械、电子、玻璃与啤酒酿造为基础，布拉格是金融与商业中心，出口以机械与运输设备为主，与德国等欧盟市场联系紧密。
economy.en: The economy rests on vehicle manufacturing, machinery, electronics, glass and brewing, with Prague as the financial and commercial centre, exports dominated by machinery and transport equipment, and close links with Germany and other EU markets.

culture.zh: 捷克文化以捷克语与波希米亚传统为基础，布拉格城堡、查理大学与众多历史城镇留下遗产，文学、音乐与电影具有国际影响，木偶戏与啤酒文化是生活标志。
culture.en: Czech culture rests on the Czech language and Bohemian tradition, with Prague Castle, Charles University and many historic towns leaving a heritage, its literature, music and cinema having international influence, and puppet theatre and beer culture marking everyday life.

events.zh: 关键节点包括9世纪波希米亚国家的形成、1918年捷克斯洛伐克建国、1989年天鹅绒革命、1993年和平分立，以及1999年加入北约与2004年加入欧盟。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the Bohemian state in the ninth century, the creation of Czechoslovakia in 1918, the Velvet Revolution of 1989, the peaceful separation of 1993 and accession to NATO in 1999 and the European Union in 2004.

value.en: In 1993 it separated peacefully from Slovakia.
It joined the European Union in 2004.

en: The Kingdom of Tlemcen, or Zayyanid Kingdom of Tlemcen, as a kingdom ruled by the Berber Zayyanid dynasty in the central Maghreb
Its rule over western Algeria from the thirteenth to the sixteenth century
zh: 特莱姆森王国又称扎亚尼德王国，是马格里布中部柏柏尔扎亚尼德王朝统治的王国
13至16世纪统治阿尔及利亚西部

politics.zh: 特莱姆森王国又称扎亚尼德王国，是马格里布中部柏柏尔扎亚尼德王朝统治的王国，1235年在穆瓦希德王朝衰落后建立，以特莱姆森为中心，领有今阿尔及利亚西部。它控制通往撒哈拉与地中海的商路，与马林王朝、哈夫斯王朝及伊比利亚基督教王国长期争夺；16世纪初在西班牙与奥斯曼压力下削弱，1554年被奥斯曼帝国吞并。
politics.en: The Kingdom of Tlemcen, also known as the Zayyanid Kingdom of Tlemcen, was a kingdom ruled by the Berber Zayyanid dynasty in the central Maghreb, established in 1235 as the Almohad empire declined and centred on Tlemcen in what is now western Algeria. It controlled the routes linking the Sahara with the Mediterranean and fought for centuries with the Marinids, the Hafsids and the Christian kingdoms of Iberia; in the early sixteenth century it weakened under Spanish and Ottoman pressure and was absorbed by the Ottoman empire in 1554.

economy.zh: 经济以特莱姆森周边的农业、手工业与跨撒哈拉贸易为基础，黄金、盐、奴隶与布匹经此流通，特莱姆森是纺织与学术中心，商队税收与过境贸易是主要财源。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming around Tlemcen, crafts and trans-Saharan trade, with gold, salt, slaves and cloth passing through, Tlemcen a centre of textiles and learning, and caravan dues and transit trade the main sources of revenue.

culture.zh: 特莱姆森王国留下伊斯兰建筑与学术遗产，清真寺、经学院与城墙见于记载，阿拉伯语与柏柏尔语并用，安达卢斯移民带来音乐与工艺传统，与格拉纳达的文化联系密切。
culture.en: The kingdom left an Islamic architectural and scholarly heritage, its mosques, colleges and walls being recorded, Arabic and Berber both in use, Andalusian immigrants bringing musical and craft traditions, and its cultural links with Granada remaining close.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1235年王国建立、13至14世纪与马林王朝的战争、15世纪安达卢斯移民的进入，以及1554年被奥斯曼帝国吞并。
events.en: Key moments are the establishment of the kingdom in 1235, its wars with the Marinids in the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries, the arrival of Andalusian immigrants in the fifteenth and its absorption by the Ottoman empire in 1554.

value.en: It was absorbed by the Ottoman empire in 1554.

en: The Orange Free State as an independent Boer republic in southern Africa
Its existence from 1854 to 1902 and its incorporation into the British Empire after the Second Boer War
zh: 奥兰治自由邦是南部非洲的独立布尔人共和国
1854至1902年存在，第二次布尔战争后被并入大英帝国

politics.zh: 奥兰治自由邦是南部非洲的独立布尔人共和国，1854年依据《布隆方丹公约》脱离英国统治建立，位于今南非中部，以布隆方丹为都，由选举产生的总统与议会治理。它与德兰士瓦共和国及英国在钻石与金矿利益上冲突，1899至1902年第二次布尔战争后战败被兼并，1910年成为南非联邦的省份之一。
politics.en: The Orange Free State was an independent Boer republic in southern Africa, established in 1854 under the Convention of Bloemfontein after the end of British rule, lying in what is now central South Africa with Bloemfontein as its capital and governed by an elected president and assembly. It clashed with the Transvaal Republic and Britain over diamond and gold interests, was defeated and annexed after the Second Boer War of 1899 to 1902, and in 1910 became a province of the Union of South Africa.

economy.zh: 经济以布尔人的农牧业为基础，羊毛与牲畜是主要出口品，1870年代钻石矿的发现与铁路建设改变了经济结构，英国资本与劳工的进入加剧了政治紧张。
economy.en: The economy rested on Boer farming and herding, with wool and livestock the main exports; the discovery of diamonds in the 1870s and railway building changed its structure, and the arrival of British capital and labour sharpened political tension.

culture.zh: 共和国以布尔人的加尔文宗传统与南非荷兰语文化为基础，共和理念与地方自治构成政治认同，与德兰士瓦及开普殖民地的布尔人保持联系，其议会与法律传统影响了后来的南非政治。
culture.en: The republic rested on Boer Calvinist tradition and Afrikaans culture, with republican ideas and local self-government forming its political identity, links with the Boers of the Transvaal and the Cape Colony remaining close, and its parliamentary and legal traditions influencing later South African politics.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1854年共和国建立、1870年代钻石矿的发现、1899至1902年第二次布尔战争，以及1910年成为南非联邦的省份。
events.en: Key moments are the establishment of the republic in 1854, the discovery of diamonds in the 1870s, the Second Boer War of 1899 to 1902 and its becoming a province of the Union of South Africa in 1910.

value.en: It was established under the Convention of Bloemfontein in 1854.

value.zh: 1902年第二次布尔战争后被兼并。
value.en: It was annexed after the Second Boer War in 1902.
